subject: Renewal kickoff & QBR window — BlueSky capacity plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BlueSky renewal kickoff — timeline & QBR windows

Team —

Quick kickoff note for BlueSky (contract anniversary 2027-03-15). They’ve signaled intent to renew with an expected capacity uplift; procurement will need a short-term term amendment and we should surface a clear uplift path + QBR cadence. I attached a lean MAP and a draft SOW snippet to start.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Week of Jan 11: outreach to procurement + exec sponsor (we'll do a joint QBR invite)
- Week of Jan 18: internal readiness (ops runbook, forecasted spend, capacity lanes)
- Feb 1–14: formal negotiations / term amendment
- Mar 1–15: final sign & handoff to Onboarding

Stakeholders (please confirm):
- Sales: Soojin (me), Karthik
- CSM / QBR: Marissa
- Solution Ops / Capacity: Grace

Immediate asks:
1) Karthik — can you include a short competitive/price position note (1 paragraph) for the outreach to procurement?
2) Marissa — please prepare an initial QBR deck stub (service health, usage trends, cost/run-rate and proposed uplift lanes).
3) Grace — can you estimate the 30/60/90 day capacity runway and any constrained GPUs we should flag?

I’ll send the external kickoff to Raj at BlueSky this morning with a calendar poll for the QBR window. Keeping it light and actionable — target 45–60m QBR.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20270108-bluesky-map-draft.xlsx (MAP), 20270108-bluesky-draft-sow.pdf (SOW snippet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@bluesky-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: BlueSky renewal kickoff & QBR — draft dates

Hi Raj —

Hope you're doing well. High level — your account comes up for renewal mid-March and we want to make this as smooth as possible while ensuring capacity and pricing match your growth plans. I've looped in our QBR lead (Marissa) and solution ops (Karthik).

Proposed agenda for a kickoff/QBR (45–60m):
- Current usage & health (Marissa)
- Capacity profile & uplift options (Karthik / Grace — internal)
- Commercial terms & timeline (me)
- Next steps / mutual action plan

Can you please confirm the right BlueSky stakeholders to include? We suggest the following windows for the QBR next week — pick any that work and we’ll send a calendar invite:
- Tue Jan 12, 10:00–11:00 PST
- Wed Jan 13, 14:00–15:00 PST
- Thu Jan 14, 09:00–10:00 PST

I attached a short MAP and a draft SOW snippet so you have context before the call. Also — if there are procurement constraints (e.g., PO process, contract owners), flag them so we can route appropriately.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20270108-bluesky-map-draft.xlsx, 20270108-bluesky-draft-sow.pdf

---

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@bluesky-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@bluesky-analytics.com>, Alan Chen <alan.chen@bluesky-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueSky renewal kickoff & QBR — draft dates

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the heads up and the materials. Confirming we are planning to renew; there is likely a 25–40% uplift in token throughput over next 12 months as we ship two new products.

Stakeholders I will bring onto the kickoff/QBR:
- Raj Patel (lead technical sponsor)
- Priya Menon (Head of Analytics / exec sponsor)
- Alan Chen (CFO / procurement loop-in)

Of the windows you suggested, Tue Jan 12 10:00 PST works best for our team. If you need a larger block, we can do Wed Jan 13 14:00 PST as backup.

A couple of pre-QBR asks:
- Can you send a short one-pager on the proposed uplift lanes (expected latency/SLAs by lane, suggested quantization/instance class)?
- We will need a 30/60/90 cost estimate (run-rate) and the deliverable that documents the capacity handoff to our infra team.

If you can share those by end of day Tue (1/12) that would help Priya prepare.

Best,
Raj
Director of Platform Engineering
BlueSky Analytics

Subject: Re: BlueSky renewal kickoff & QBR — confirmed (Tue 1/12 10:00 PST)

Raj / team —

Thanks — confirmed for Tue Jan 12 10:00–11:00 PST (invite sent). Marissa will lead the QBR and we’ll have Karthik/Grace present the capacity lanes. Quick immediate follow-ups / action items: 

- Karthik: one-pager on uplift lanes + recommended instance/quantization options (due EOD Tue 1/12) — see attached snippet 'bluesky-capacity-runbook-snippet.md'.
- Grace: 30/60/90 capacity run-rate estimates and top-of-stack constraints (due Wed 1/13 COB).
- Marissa: QBR deck stub (first pass) and service health slide (due Wed 1/13).
- Soojin: I will draft the term amendment language and share a redline by Jan 20; will include a stair-step pricing option aligned to volumes.

Also noting procurement ask from Raj: we will include a small appendix in the SOW with the capacity handoff checklist for BlueSky's infra/security teams.

If anything changes on your end Raj, flag it here and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bluesky-capacity-runbook-snippet.md (ops summary)
